title: Clean paper dataset
description: Schema for the cleaned paper records derived from papers_clean.json.

paper_id.description: Lowercase DOI. Records without a DOI or with a duplicate DOI are dropped.

title.description: Normalized paper title; duplicate titles are detected case-insensitively.

authors_joined.description: Authors joined into one string; empty values are replaced with Unknown.

categories_joined.description: Categories joined into one string; falls back to container-title and type, then Uncategorized.

published.description: Publication date in ISO 8601 date format. Records with unparseable dates are dropped.

age_days.description: Signed number of days from published to the pipeline run date; negative means future-dated.

text_for_embedding.description: Embedding text regenerated from title, authors_joined, categories_joined, published, and summary.

paper.$comment: Dataset-level validation must additionally drop duplicate paper_id values and duplicate title.lower() values.
